112:3.text: He neither begets nor is born,

112:4.text: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

113:1.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

113:2.text: From the evil of that which He created

113:3.text: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

113:4.text: And from the evil of the blowers in knots

113:5.text: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

114:1.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

114:4.text: From the evil of the retreating whisperer

114:6.text: From among the jinn and mankind".
